title: Stock and Flow Notation Explorer
description: Click parts of a bathtub-style stock-and-flow diagram to see how each maps onto the causal loop diagram from Chapter 3.
creator: Systems Thinking in the Age of AI
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Systems Thinking in the Age of AI
Feedback, Delay, and Loop Dynamics

educational.learningObjective: Given a simple causal loop diagram, the learner will identify the corresponding stock, inflow and outflow in an equivalent stock-and-flow diagram.
prerequisites: Has read a causal loop diagram
Knows that some quantities accumulate over time
learningOutcomes: Map a CLD node onto its stock-and-flow counterpart
Identify the stock, the inflow and the outflow in a stock-and-flow diagram
Explain what a stock-and-flow diagram shows that a CLD cannot
educational.assessmentOpportunity: Give learners a two-node CLD and ask them to name the stock, the inflow, and any outflow the CLD failed to show.

pedagogical.instructionalStrategy: Dual coding - the same system shown in two notations simultaneously
pedagogical.feedbackType: Synchronized highlighting across both diagrams plus an explanation sentence
misconceptionsAddressed: That a CLD and a stock-and-flow diagram carry the same information
That a flow and a stock are interchangeable ways of describing a quantity
discussionQuestions: Why would you ever use a CLD if a stock-and-flow diagram carries more information?
What real quantities in your work are stocks, and which are flows?
Why is confusing a stock with a flow such a common and costly error?
